set.body: Migration of the release-evidence repair from the mistakenly used Beads tracker. Frozen before inspecting any NHANES 2013-2014 outcomes: the 2017-2018 evaluation is post-hoc model-development evidence because it informed the demographic scale terms. Untouched confirmation will refit the already-fixed SHASH specification on NHANES 2015-2016 and evaluate NHANES 2013-2014 from DEMO_H.XPT and BMX_H.XPT. The frozen contract is adults age 18-79; outcomes height_cm, weight_kg, bmi, waist_cm; location s(age,k=8)+sex+race_ethnicity; scale s(age,k=5)+sex+race_ethnicity; intercept-only skew and tail; simple random sample without replacement of min(2000,population) using seed 20260824; total uncertainty with 1000 draws; unchanged acceptable_calibration rules, valid fits, held-out status, complete finite evidence, and minimum outcome n at least 500. No model, sample, seed, threshold, or wording may be changed after outcomes are observed; a failed confirmation remains a retained failure. Also make HBR/site evidence fail-closed by retaining raw tables, recording SHA-256 plus schema/row counts, and recomputing convergence, summaries, gates, and receipt verdicts rather than trusting booleans.
set.title: Repair evidence trust narrative and receipts
